general.ayuda_contenido: Check the current status, choose a configurable module and review the proposed status and reason. Preparing a request does not change the configuration. Applying it requires an authorised service that records changes, which is still pending. Enabling a module does not grant access permissions.
general.limite: Actual changes are disabled. The authorised service that stores and records the configuration is not yet connected.

consulta.descripcion: Statuses received from the central module catalogue.
consulta.pendiente: Configuration unavailable: no service is connected to retrieve current statuses yet.
consulta.disponible: Configuration loaded. You can prepare a request without changing current statuses.
consulta.vacia: The queried catalogue contains no modules. There are no requests to prepare.
consulta.sin_gobernados: The queried modules are outside this control. You cannot prepare changes here.
consulta.denegada: You do not have access to this configuration. Request the required administrative authorisation.
consulta.incompatible: The received configuration cannot be used. Refresh it; if the problem persists, contact IT.
consulta.error: The configuration could not be loaded. Select Refresh configuration to try again.

preparacion.pista_motivo: Explain the change in up to 500 characters. Avoid including personal data.

revision.limite: This preparation does not enable or disable the module. Its current status stays the same.
revision.dependencia: Only the proposal will be prepared. Applying actual changes is still pending.
revision.sin_preparador: Preparation disabled: the service that reviews the proposal is not yet connected.
revision.preparada: Request prepared for review. The current configuration has not changed.

errores.sin_cambio: Choose a status different from the current one.
errores.motivo: Enter a reason between 1 and 500 characters long.
errores.conflicto: The configuration has changed. Refresh it and review the request before preparing it again.
errores.preparacion: The request could not be prepared. Check the details and try again.
